title: Hardship Deferment Limits for Home-Only Loan Programs
content:
**Hearthstone Home Finance hardship assistance matrix — Home Purchase Financing**

| Program | Deferment offered | Installments per deferment (most) | Deferments per trailing 12 months (most) | Installments deferred over the loan's life (most) | Installments paid since funding (least) | Days past due of the oldest unpaid installment (most) | Deferment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | yes | 1 | 1 | 3 | 12 | 59 | 35.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | yes | 1 | 1 | 4 | 12 | 59 | 35.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | yes | 2 | 1 | 6 | 12 | 59 | 50.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | yes | 2 | 1 | 6 | 12 | 59 | 50.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | yes | 2 | 1 | 6 | 12 | 59 | 50.00 |

"Not applicable" marks a limit with no meaning on a program that offers no deferment.

**How the columns read (hypothetical loans)**

- A Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed loan with 12 installments paid meets the least-installments column; with 11 it does not.
- An oldest unpaid installment 59 days past due is within the matrix's most; 60 days past due is beyond it.
- On the Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed program, a loan that has already deferred 3 installments over its life has reached that program's lifetime most; on a 20-Year loan the same history leaves 3 more installments available under the lifetime column.
